title: Ideas
why: It is the one place two screens are composed inside a third, which is exactly where a duplicated heading hides — and a duplicated heading is a structural fault that a pixel diff describes badly and a semantic assertion names in one line.

measurements.note: Semantic, not pixel. A child screen drawing its own heading under the switch that already named the page is a structural duplication: the picture shows two words and says nothing about which one is wrong. This asserts the count and names the offender.
